meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 ETE 工具包处理系统发育树或层次树：读写 Newick/Nexus 格式，修剪、重定根、解析多歧枝，比较树的拓扑距离，检测基因复制/分化事件，关联 NCBI 分类，并渲染成 PDF/SVG 图。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析、操作、比较、注释或可视化系统发育树/层次树时触发，例如读取 Newick/Nexus 文件、计算 Robinson-Foulds 距离、检测进化事件等。不用于从原始序列推断树。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Newick 文件读进来，显示叶子数和节点数。
比较这两棵树，给出 Robinson-Foulds 距离和独有分支。
say.note: 会返回 RF 距离和拓扑差异。

say.text: 用 NCBI 分类库给这些叶子添加物种和谱系注释。
say.note: 会自动下载/缓存分类库并标注。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the ETE toolkit to handle phylogenetic or hierarchical trees: read/write Newick and Nexus formats, prune, reroot, resolve polytomies, compare tree topologies, detect gene duplication/speciation events, link NCBI taxonomy, and render to PDF/SVG.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests to analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, or visualize phylogenetic/hierarchical trees, e.g., reading Newick/Nexus files, computing RF distances, detecting events. Not for inferring trees from sequences.

say_en.text: Read this Newick file and show leaf and node counts.
Compare these two trees and return the RF distance and unique partitions.
say_en.note: Returns RF distance and topology differences.

say_en.text: Annotate these leaves with NCBI taxonomy and lineage.
